topic.title: Turtle Import Styles
topic.description: Demonstrates three ways to import the Turtle module: import turtle, from turtle import Turtle, and import turtle as t. Clarifies Python import mechanics.

learningNotes.whatILearned: The difference between module-level imports and object imports, and how aliases reduce typing.
learningNotes.challenges: Understanding namespace differences between each import style.
learningNotes.nextSteps: Apply import patterns to other standard library modules.

files.description: Three import style examples for the turtle module.
